Subject: Onboard: OneTrust service account + SSO for bulk evidence sync

Hi Samantha / OneTrust API team,

We're preparing to push a larger evidence sync (SOC 2 + SIG artifacts) into our OneTrust tenant and want to onboard an automated integration rather than manual uploads. Scope and asks below — please let me know if we should open a support ticket or schedule a short tech call.

Goal:
- Create a dedicated service account in OneTrust for automated evidence ingestion from our internal evidence fabric.
- Provision SSO/SAML for the service account (we prefer a service principal that can be federated via our IdP).
- Provide an API client or token with scoped permissions limited to evidence.upload and evidence.read for a staging tenant first.

What we can provide:
- SAML metadata for our IdP (Okta) and a suggested subject identifier.
- A sample manifest of the payload and the filename conventions (attached).
- A CSV with account and contact info (attached).

Questions:
1) Do you support service principals backed by SAML assertions (i.e., non-human service accounts tied to our IdP)?
2) What exact permission roles are required for bulk evidence uploads and for cleaning up staging objects?
3) Token rotation / key lifetime recommendations and whether we can use short-lived OAuth tokens instead of long-lived API keys.
4) Any rate limits on bulk multipart uploads (we anticipate bursts of ~300–400 files during initial seeding).

Attachments: onetrust_service_account_template.csv; evidence_upload_manifest_sample.json

If it helps, we can target a short call next week to walk through the staging flow.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Program Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Onboard: OneTrust service account + SSO for bulk evidence sync

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the clear outline.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we support non-human service accounts federated via SAML/OIDC (Okta works fine).
- For bulk evidence ingestion you'll want the Evidence Uploader role (evidence.upload), plus evidence.manage if you need the integration to delete/overwrite objects in staging.
- We recommend OAuth2 with short-lived tokens (1 hour) and a refresh token rotation cadence; if that's not feasible we can issue scoped API clients with 30-day keys and an automatic rotation reminder.
- Rate limits: staging allows bursts up to 1,000 file operations in a 10-minute window; production is stricter — we can open a quota exception during onboarding.

Required from your side to get a service account provisioned in staging:
1) SAML metadata (IdP XML) and the desired subject/email for the service principal.
2) A CSV mapping of the Redwood internal owner (contact) and the intended service account name — your template looks fine.
3) The sample manifest/payload structure (we reviewed the attached JSON sample; minor schema note below).

Schema note: in your sample manifest we saw a top-level "artifact_type" set to "doc" — for SIG evidence please prefer the CAIQ artifact_type value set to "caiq_document" so downstream parsing tags correctly.

Next steps:
- I can provision a staging client and create a temporary service principal if you send the SAML metadata.
- I'll schedule a 30-minute tech call to validate an initial 100-file seed and verify rate behavior.

Proposed times: Tue 2026-11-10 10:00–10:30 PST or Wed 2026-11-11 14:00–14:30 PST. Which works?

Link to API docs (staging): https://support.onetrust.com/docs/api-evidence-upload

Best,
Samantha Reed
Integrations Lead — Technical Onboarding
OneTrust

Thanks Samantha — copying what we'll run on our side so the tech call can be narrow: 

Planned Redwood approach:
- We'll create an internal service identity: svc_onetrust_upload@redwood.com (non-human).
- Federate via Okta using SAML metadata Evelyn will supply; the IdP subject will be the service email above.
- Create a short-lived runner (K8s job) that converts internal S3 object metadata into the upload manifest and posts multipart uploads to OneTrust.
- Rate shaping: stagger files in 50-file chunks with small pauses to avoid burst backpressure; we'll run an initial 100-file seed in staging.
- Rotation: implement automated refresh token rotation daily (with a 30-day fallback key) and store secrets in our KMS (AWS Secrets Manager).

Operational asks for OneTrust ops team:
- Please enable a staging quota bump for 24 hours during the seed (we'll limit to the window we agree).
- Confirm the evidence.delete permission is available under "evidence.manage" (we want to be able to remove duplicates from staging).
- Share the JWKS/SAML endpoints for validation and any expected cert rollover windows.

I'll take Tue 11/10 10:00 PST for the tech validation call — Marcus.
